conflictPairs.topic: Optical transition estimates for 0.75 equivalent EDTA
conflictPairs.context: Both estimates concern the 0.75 equivalent EDTA chloride synthesis and are Tauc-based. The main text reports 393 nm and directs the reader to the SI method, while the SI plot is annotated 3.14 eV = 395 nm. The source does not explain this numerical discrepancy; neither value is replaced, averaged or recalculated.

claims.label: Main-text LEET
claims.statement: The main text estimates the lowest-energy electronic transition using a Tauc plot as 393 nm and refers to the SI method; 393 nm is repeated in the particle-size model discussion.
claims.sourceLocator: Main PDF p.2, Tauc-estimated transition; p.3, particle-size model discussion

claims.label: SI Tauc annotation
claims.statement: The SI Tauc plot is annotated 3.14 eV = 395 nm.
claims.sourceLocator: SI p.16, lowest-energy electronic transition calculation

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation
